mapper.select: SELECT role_id, role_name, is_expanded, color, sort_order FROM roles ORDER BY sort_order ASC, role_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO roles (role_name, color, sort_order, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{roleName}, #{color}, COALESCE(#{sortOrder}, 0), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE roles SET sort_order = #{sortOrder} WHERE role_id = #{roleId}
